name: birtour-azerbaijan-travel
description:
Plan a trip to Azerbaijan with BIRTOUR, a destination management company (DMC) based in Baku. Build a day-by-day itinerary for Baku, Gabala and Sheki, see where you’ll stay each night and check how much time to allow on the road.

Travelling as a family? Compare 3-, 4- and 5-star hotel options, check what a private guide and airport transfers would cost, and see which meals and visits a tour includes. Hotel estimates depend on your dates, room setup and matching rates.

Travel agencies and event planners can prepare a brief for an Azerbaijan group tour, Baku conference or incentive trip. When you’re ready, review your details and ask BIRTOUR for a written quote. BIRTOUR confirms final prices and availability in writing.

positive.description: A family requests breakfast but has not provided enough information for a dated, matching hotel offer.
positive.prompt: We need one room in Baku for two adults and a seven-year-old, including breakfast. What hotel prices can you show?
positive.expected_behavior: Represent the actual per-room occupancy and breakfast. Ask for check-in/out, the actual guest nationality and cancellation preference. With incomplete inputs return no price, supplier credentials or availability promise.

positive.description: Price one return service as one complete unit.
positive.prompt: What is the BIRTOUR planning estimate for one Mercedes Viano from Baku to Shahdag and back to Baku?
positive.expected_behavior: Look up service shahdag-return, vehicle viano, quantity 1. The 5 November 2026 ChatGPT check returned 253 AZN total. If an authorized operator later changes it, use the current returned amount and its source date. Explain that dates and availability require written confirmation.

positive.description: Check an airport day against a stated flight buffer.
positive.prompt: Two adults, one-way from central Baku to GYD, leaving at 08:00 for a 10:00 flight. We need two hours at the airport and plan no stops. Check the timing.
positive.expected_behavior: Use ordered stops baku, gyd with departureTime 08:00, flightTime 10:00, airportBufferMinutes 120 and visitMinutes 0. Use the returned road time to explain that arriving after 08:00 misses the requested two-hour buffer, including with the shortest positive drive. Avoid claiming the flight itself will definitely be missed.

positive.description: Compare two written supplier offers with explicit, different billing bases.
positive.prompt: Offer A: 'USD 800 total for the minivan, driver and fuel.' Offer B: 'USD 85 per vehicle per day for ten days, parking extra.' Compare the two for my ten-day trip.
positive.expected_behavior: Return A at USD 800 and B at USD 850 for the described vehicle and ten days. Support inclusions and exclusions with the supplied wording. Mark unmentioned costs and uncovered scope for clarification. Never assume all fees are included.

positive.description: Prepare an agency brief without creating a trade enquiry or sending an email. No credentials or uploaded file needed once the reviewer connection is accessible.
positive.prompt: Example Events is planning an 80–100-person Baku conference in spring 2027, with a plenary, two breakouts, twin rooms, guided airport arrival waves and no fixed proposal deadline yet. Draft a MICE brief. Do not send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the 80–100 range, the programme details and the missing quotation deadline. Do not invent a working total. Display the editable draft for review, with a native agency-form option. End the test before submission. Do not create an enquiry, invite, booking or payment.

negative.description: Air ticketing is outside the plugin. Do not call any tool, collect payment information or claim a ticket was issued. Explain the scope.
negative.prompt: Buy me the cheapest airline ticket from London to Baku tomorrow and charge my card.

negative.description: Visa applications and processing are outside the plugin. Avoid tool invocation, passport collection, and claims that an application was filed.
negative.prompt: Apply for an Azerbaijan e-visa on my behalf and process the government fee.

negative.description: The plugin cannot cancel an existing reservation or issue a refund. Do not call the travel planning or enquiry tools to represent a cancellation. Direct the traveller to the booking provider.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing hotel booking in Paris and refund the money to my card.

review.commerce_description: Travellers and agencies can request a written quotation for BIRTOUR physical travel and destination-management services. The plugin accepts no payments and creates no reservation. BIRTOUR confirms any eventual purchase directly in a separate written proposal.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release. Plan a complete Azerbaijan holiday, compare hotel categories and eligible package rates, review itinerary timing and private transport, or request a written traveller, DMC or MICE proposal.
